guitar.notes: Eddie Hazel (famed for the 'Maggot Brain' solo) is the band's most famous guitarist, generally associated with Stratocasters; medium confidence as documentation of a specific signature model is thinner.

tone.summary: A tight, bright funk rhythm tone achieved with a clean pre-amp (Boost/Comp), followed by the wah pedal, into a classic American clean amp model (US Deluxe) paired with a smaller cab (US 2x12).
